title: الفصل الثالث من الباب الثالث في صفة قلم الحكيم افلاطون
titleParaphrase: Third section of the third chapter: on the form of the pen (script) of the sage Aflāṭūn (Plato). Paraphrase by the tracer, not a quotation of any translation.
headingHammer: SECTION III. The alphabet of Plato, (v. orig. p. 18.)
headingHammerLocator: Hammer's English part, p. [5] (leaf 35 of the scan, b22039910_0035.jp2), read on the leaf by the tracer.

primary.copy: Wellcome Library copy, digitised for the Internet Archive as item b22039910 (rights field: Creative Commons Public Domain Mark, as recorded in plates/ibn-wahshiyya.manifest.json).
primary.work: Joseph Hammer (ed. and trans.), Ancient Alphabets and Hieroglyphic Characters Explained (London: W. Bulmer and Co., 1806): the Arabic text of Shawq al-mustahām, Bāb III, faṣl 3, the pen of the sage Aflāṭūn (Plato).
primary.locator: Arabic part, p. 18 (printed "18" and "١٨" at the head of the page), the one table on the page, under its heading; leaf 205 of the scan (b22039910_0205.jp2), Internet Archive page n204. The book's Arabic part is paginated from the back, so in the scan Arabic p. 18 is leaf 205.
primary.plate: plates/ibn-wahshiyya/plato/table.png (an exact pixel copy of leaf 205 at offset 290, 940: checked, zero difference); the cells were cut from b22039910_0205.jp2 itself.
primary.urlCheck: Both URLs fetched by the tracer on 2026-10-20 (HTTP 200). The page image (2093 x 2896 px) matches leaf 205 of the JP2 set (greyscale correlation 0.999; against a different leaf 0.08).
primary.valuesPrinted: yes: an Arabic letter is printed under each sign; every one is legible.

layout: Three rows read from right to left: 9 signs (ا to ط), 9 signs (ي to ص), and 4 signs (ق ر ش ت) centred. Small round separator dots stand between the signs; they are not part of any sign and are not drawn.
cellSize: One cell size for the whole table: a 160 px square cut from the leaf (300 ppi), centred on the sign's ink, upscaled x3 (Lanczos) to 480 px. 1 glyph unit = 1.6 leaf px. Neighbouring separator dots show at the edges of some cells.
tracing: Centre lines traced over a skeleton of the inked strokes (threshold 128 of 255 on the greyscale leaf) and checked by overlay. The print's line is heavier (about 6 to 8 units wide) than the kit pen (5.5).
variantsNote: Checked against two further copies of the 1806 printing: the Getty Research Institute copy (Internet Archive ancientalphabets01ibnw, page n206) and the University of North Carolina copy (ancientalphabets00ibnw, page n23). All 22 signs have the same form in the three copies; the two other copies settle two details of the Wellcome print (the dot between the legs of س is printed in all three; the dash above ف is in the Wellcome copy only). The two Oxford copies scanned by Google and the BSB scan listed in plates/ibn-wahshiyya.manifest.json were not compared, and no manuscript was consulted.

letters.name: qāf
letters.strokes: a zigzag (somewhat like %): from a small ring on the left a stroke rises to a sharp point at the upper right, turns back and runs the whole height down to a sharp point at the lower left, and turns again to rise to a small ring on the right
letters.note: Each outer stroke meets the long stroke at its tip in a sharp turn: the paper shows between the strokes almost to the two tips, plainest in the Getty and UNC copies. The two loops are open in all three copies and are drawn as rings of radius 6.5 units; in the print the left one is drawn out sideways and pointed toward its stroke, the right one a little wider than tall. A speck of about 1 unit inside the right-hand loop's angle in the Getty and UNC copies (not in the Wellcome copy) is not drawn.

otherCopies.method: Each page image was registered onto the Wellcome leaf (SIFT features on the table, similarity transform fitted with RANSAC; scale about 1.24 to 1.26, rotation under half a degree), each Wellcome cell frame was mapped into it and refined by a local correlation search (shifts of 0 to 3 units; correlation 0.94 to 0.98 except where the sign itself differs), so the cells of all three copies share the glyph frame. The page images were fetched on 2026-10-20 and kept outside the site; they serve only as witnesses.

check.summary: Every sign compared with the Wellcome print and with the Getty and UNC copies, registered onto the same cells: label and order, strokes, joins, direction, ends, dots and proportion. Corrected: ق (redrawn as a zigzag whose outer strokes meet the long stroke at its tips), س (the dot between the legs added), ب (the base now runs past the foot of the left side), ت (the bar extended to its printed length); ف re-rated high (the dash above it is a mark of the Wellcome copy only).
